1 Document Information and Content
This auxiliary document provides a collection of constraints for AUTOSAR models. All
constraints are copied from template speciﬁcation and software speciﬁcation docu-
ments, so this document does not introduce any new constraints.
A list of the documents that the constraints originate from can be found in the table of
contents. Chapter 2 contains the collected constraints, grouped by source documents.
All constraints from the same source document are contained within a single section.
